executed.finding: PR #420 sampled time.monotonic() before _buckets_lock. Reverse sample/acquisition order could compute a negative refill, falsely refuse an available bucket, emit a false Retry-After, and rewind the bucket last timestamp.
executed.requested_fix: Move time.monotonic() inside _buckets_lock and add a deterministic reverse sample/acquisition regression asserting last never regresses and an available bucket is not refused.

executed.verification: Requested fix is present: time.monotonic() now samples inside _buckets_lock. The new test_take_samples_the_clock_inside_the_lock forces the reverse acquisition ordering and asserts no false refusal, non-negative tokens, and monotone last.
